column1: # R19 RED suite manifest — one row per ADVERSARIAL_RESULTS.md ledger entry.
#   requires   what the row needs to run: none | cap_bpf | deferred
#   package    cargo package, or "-" for a non-cargo/deferred row
#   selector   cargo test filter that runs exactly the test(s) asserting
#   ledger     the outcome the ledger records for this row
# A row with requires=none is REPRODUCED when its selector's tests pass.
# A row with requires=cap_bpf is BLOCKED unless the host has CAP_BPF, CAP_PERFMON
#   and tracefs — the live kernel-gate attack cannot run without them, and the
#   suite says so rather than pretending. Those rows are already sealed in the
#   ledger from a host that had them (Linux 6.18.44); this harness reproduces
#   the off-host half of the same property (OI-09..OI-12) with requires=none.
# A row with requires=deferred is blocked on a component that does not exist
#   yet; the ledger names it. Never reported as reproduced.
# A row with requires=note records a boundary, not a runnable detection (e.g.
#   what a key holder can and cannot do). Its selector names the closest
#   asserting test, which the suite runs, but its ledger cell is the boundary
#   statement, not DETECTED. Reported as NOTE, never as a pass or a failure.
